title: Legacy program insiders on UFO materials

tellings.quote: that's how people who are in the quote unquote UFO legacy program talk about UFO materials.

plain: Some people are said to belong to a "UFO legacy program", a name for a supposed secret US government effort, passed down over decades, that holds and studies UFO materials, and these insiders are said to have their own way of talking about those materials. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, while arguing with a skeptic on the show; it matters because, if true, it would mean such a programme exists and has people inside it.
